rules.question: Is the Abstract page free of any visible page number?
rules.rule_definition: The Abstract page must show no visible page number.
rules.remediation: Delete the visible page number from the Abstract page.

rules.question: Look at the very first word of the first body paragraph. Is its starting position horizontally aligned perfectly with the left edge of the text block, showing zero indentation?
rules.rule_definition: The first Abstract paragraph must begin flush with the left paragraph margin.
rules.remediation: Remove the first-line indent from the first Abstract paragraph.

rules.question: Look at the left side of Paragraph 2. Imagine the left edge of the main body text is a solid vertical wall. Is the top line of the paragraph pushed inward to the right, creating a visible "step" or empty cutout at the top left corner? Repeat this check for any subsequent paragraphs.
rules.rule_definition: Every Abstract paragraph after the first must begin with a visible first-line indent.
rules.remediation: Apply a first-line indent to every Abstract paragraph after the first.

rules.question: Does the Abstract text contain any standalone form of the words “paper” or “article,” including plurals?

rules.remediation: Replace “paper” or “article” with “dissertation,” “study,” “work,” or “research.”

rules.question: Is the Abstract text completely free of first-person pronouns (I, me, my, we, etc.)?
rules.rule_definition: The Abstract must not contain first-person pronouns.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the sentence or sentences to remove first-person pronouns.
